title: SirLaughalotMC Plays Create Modpack
description: The Official Modpack for Laughy's Create Mod singleplayer series. Mild QOL mods, performance mods, chunk loaders, create and farmers delight with minimal add-ons.
body:
The official modpack for SirLaughalotMCs singleplayer Create mod series.

The aim for this pack was to be predominantly a playthrough of base create with minimal changes to get the "vanilla" create experience.

Features Quality of Life mods:
- Appleskin
- Better Brightness Slider
- Drop-Down Keybindings
- Freecam
- Iris
- JEI
- JustZoom
- Mod Menu
- Xero's World Map and Minimap

Performance Mods:
- Sodium
- Lithium
- Chunky

Create Mods:
- Create
- Create Deco
- Create Slice and Dice
- Create: Copycats+
- Create: Rustic Structures

Other Major Mods:
- Vanilla Backport
- Farmer's Delight
- Chunk Loaders

Includes other minor mods and libraries.
